items.text: U.S. Representative since 2005; currently represents California's 21st District. (sources: Office of Rep. Jim Costa (house.gov) https://costa.house.gov/about/full-biography [search summary, primary]; Voteview (UCLA) https://voteview.com/person/20501/jim-costa [search summary, secondary])

items.label: California Legislature
items.text: Served 24 years in the California State Legislature; elected to the State Assembly in 1978. (sources: Office of Rep. Jim Costa (house.gov) https://costa.house.gov/about/full-biography [search summary, primary]; JoinCalifornia https://www.joincalifornia.com/candidate/3946 [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Occupation
items.text: Owner of Club One Casino in Fresno; president of the California Gaming Association; founder of the Kirkland Foundation; former chairman of Steinway Musical Instruments. (sources: San Joaquin Valley Sun https://sjvsun.com/?p=101910 [search summary, secondary]; The Business Journal https://thebusinessjournal.com/kirkland-announces-run-for-congress [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Education
items.text: A.B., Harvard University, 1984; M.B.A., Stanford University, 1988 (single source). (sources: iVoterGuide https://ivoterguide.com/candidate/78525/race/25582/election/1385 [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Prior candidacy
items.text: Candidate in the 2024 special election for California's 20th District after Kevin McCarthy's resignation; did not advance past the primary. (sources: GV Wire https://gvwire.com/2023/12/13/fresno-casino-owner-former-navy-combat-pilot-enter-race-for-mccarthys-seat/ [search summary, secondary]; Mid Valley Times https://midvalleytimes.com/article/news/2026/10/08/costa-kirkland-face-off-for-congressional-district-21/ [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Party registration
items.text: The SoS party preference history lists Republican from 2023 to 2026; news coverage reports that he declined to state a party for some years before re-registering as a Republican. (sources: California Secretary of State https://elections.cdn.sos.ca.gov/statewide-elections/2026-general/pph.pdf [search summary, primary]; San Joaquin Valley Sun https://sjvsun.com/?p=101910 [search summary, secondary])
